messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: stretched projective orbit of a finite reflection group

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving a minimum triangle area of at least 1/243 arises from placing a stretched orbit of the Coxeter group H_3 (the reflection group of the icosahedron, of order 120) under the map (x,y,z) -> (x,y), scaled to fill [0,1]^2; the stretch parameter t is tuned so that the projected orbit of a generic interior point yields 13 distinct points after quotienting the symmetry, and the minimum-area triangle is bounded below by the reciprocal of the absolute discriminant of the stretched H_3 root lattice."}
